ruleset.name: loudsight-documentation
ruleset.description:
A curated subset of PMD's documentation category, covering main AND test sources.
Only the three rules that catch a mistake are enabled. The category's other three measure comment volume, which is not the same thing as comment quality and would push this codebase toward the restating-the-obvious Javadoc it currently avoids.
Enabled: - DanglingJavadoc - a /** block somewhere the tool will never associate with a declaration, so documentation someone wrote is silently not documentation. - UncommentedEmptyConstructor / UncommentedEmptyMethodBody - an empty body is either deliberate, in which case say so, or an unfinished implementation. Both have shipped here before.
Deliberately excluded: - CommentRequired - would demand Javadoc on every declaration, generating thousands of findings whose only cheap fix is filler text. - CommentSize - line and length limits on comments; this tree's explanatory comments are long on purpose, and several are cited from the plan documents. - CommentContent - a banned-word scan that does nothing until configured with words.
